narr: A strong and slow moving thunderstorm south of Lake Charles produced 10 to 20 inches of rain during the evening.
ev: Numerous roadways were flooded and impassable in Hackberry and Grand Lake. A maximum rainfall amount reported was just over 19 inches in Hackberry with around 1 foot common in Grand Lake. The majority of the rain occurred during 3 hours. Three homes had minor flooding during the event in Grand Lake.
Numerous roads were flooded near the Calcasieu-Cameron Parish line. A high water rescue was conducted near the intersection of Helms and Tom Hebert Roads when a car became stranded.
